<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex58032024-01-3014-06-11" ana="corpusmd:colophon" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (13b5–13b6)"/>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5042">slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i lugs kyi smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi cho ga</rs> 'di || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6311">yang dag pa'i yongs kyi dge ba'i <abbr>bshes gnyen</abbr> 'jam dpal <abbr>rdo rje</abbr> snying po</rs>'i bkas bskul nas | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4066">thogs med</rs> kyis sbyar ba 'dis | 'gro ba mang po la phan <abbr>thogs</abbr> shing <lb n="13b6"/> 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems par gyur cig | shub+haM ||</seg></TEI>
